title: ChitroJera: A Regionally Relevant Visual Question Answering Dataset for Bangla

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on a regionally relevant Bangla VQA dataset and performing qualitative error analysis on culturally specific actions and concepts (e.g., identifying Western bias in failing to recognize rural agricultural practices).
Benchmarking and comparing the performance of monolingual (primarily English-focused) large language models against multilingual models on a Bangla visual question answering dataset.
Comparing model accuracy on visual question answering tasks with and without the inclusion of accompanying image captions to assess the model's reliance on text versus visual reasoning.
